liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Reviewer had waited all summer to hear it, having missed it at three New York shows and one Connecticut show [8]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The stretch after drums, Hard Rain into Help>Slip>Franklin's Tower and One More Saturday Night, was singled out as incredible [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Miracle**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [18]
- **Ramblin Rose**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- **Box of Rain**: rare: 11 archived performances [18]
- **Hard Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [18]
- **Help**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [18]
- **Slip**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [18]
- **call back**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [18]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Dire Wolf, Knockin On Heavens Door [18]

## The recordings

- **DCO2016-07-09.MK22** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **Deadnco2016-07-09**: source not stated; 18 songs; 185 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]
- **deadandcompany2016-07-09.mk41.perks.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **deadandcompany2016-07-09.mk5.perks.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer marked 30 years since their first show, which was at Alpine Valley in 1986 [6]
- Reviewer found the light show spectacular, at times looking almost three-dimensional [6]
- Reviewer says security stopped them from coming over to talk with the taper and listen [9]
- Reviewer says security stopped them from coming over to talk with the taper and listen [10]
- Reviewer considers this the best show of the tour [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DCO2016-07-09.MK22**: taped by soling; transferred by soling; source: Schoeps MK22 (wide ORTF) > KC5 > CMC6 > V3 > Sound Devices 744t @ 24bit/48hz [1]
- **Deadnco2016-07-09**: taped by tyedyejon/taperjon [3]. Also: Recorded with two ME66 microphones in XY configuration into a Sound Devices 552 [3]
- **deadandcompany2016-07-09.mk41.perks.flac24**: taped by perks; transferred by perks; source: Schoeps MK41's DINa > active cables > Naiant PFA > Sound Devices MP-2 > Tascam DR-680 @ 24/48. Recorded from OTS (sec 202 - Row BBB - seat 112 & 113.) [2]
- **deadandcompany2016-07-09.mk5.perks.flac24**: taped by perks; transferred by perks; source: Schoeps MK5's - omni setting split 3' > active cables > Nbox > Tascam DR-680 @ 24/48. Recorded from OTS (sec 202 - Row BBB - seat 112 & 113.) [4]
